comparison_rule: For each condition, compare each fixed new candidate with the fastest median among all twenty frozen prior candidates (including pdqsort). This is a retrospective reference, not an implemented selector. Also report comparison with the previous compact candidate measured in the same run.
stage_policy: Eight exactly reused phase-one input-bank conditions are known calibration. Twelve new seed-bank conditions are a targeted fresh evaluation designed after observing phase-one failure families. Four deterministic mechanisms are separate. Fresh does not imply an unbiased population of real workloads or that the families were conceptually unseen.
uncertainty: Eight fixed banks, seven within-process randomized-order rounds. Quantiles and a10% margin are descriptive, not confidence intervals or significance tests. Per-condition geometric means weight conditions equally, not by array size or deployment prevalence.
